contracts.commit_point: possible_path.open("rb") at src/agent/callbacks.py:81 with bytes read at line 82; admitted content is subsequently persisted via callback_context.save_artifact(filename="user:current_medical_image", ...) at callbacks.py:88-90.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Pre-open path-containment check: possible_path = Path(match.group(1)).resolve() (callbacks.py:65), then `if not possible_path.is_relative_to(Path.cwd())` triggers logger.warning("Access denied: Path ... is outside the working directory.") and `continue` (callbacks.py:68-73), skipping the open for non-contained paths.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Opening/reading a local image file whose path was extracted from user prompt text when the resolved path is not relative to Path.cwd() (i.e., possible_path.is_relative_to(Path.cwd()) evaluates False), meaning the path resolves outside the current working directory.
pending_binding_information: Whether the runtime working directory (Path.cwd()) is pinned to an approved root at deployment; no configuration in the supplied source sets or constrains it.

Whether load_image_artifact (callbacks.py:99-122), which appends the saved 'user:current_medical_image' artifact to LLM requests, is registered anywhere; it is not referenced in the supplied src/agent/agent.py.

Whether the sub-agents (icd10, image_analysis, soap wired via AgentTool at agent.py:35-37) register save_image_to_artifact or perform their own local-path file reads; the sub_agents module sources are not supplied.
contracts.protected_operation: Local filesystem open/read of the regex-extracted image path inside save_image_to_artifact: possible_path.open("rb") and f.read() (src/agent/callbacks.py:81-82), which feeds construction of the image Part.
contracts.protected_resource: Local image files on the host filesystem addressed by user-supplied path strings embedded in prompt text; files resolving outside the current working directory must not be readable through this callback path.
contracts.protection_obligation: In save_image_to_artifact (registered as a root-agent before_agent_callback at src/agent/agent.py:29), a local image file path extracted from user prompt text may only be opened and read if its resolved path is contained within the current working directory; otherwise access must be denied (logged and skipped) before any local file read or downstream artifact ingestion.
scope_limits: Guard applies only to text parts whose stripped text ends with .jpg/.jpeg/.png and from which the regex at callbacks.py:60-62 extracts a path; inline_data image parts are saved unconditionally with no path check (callbacks.py:35-48).
Containment reference is the process working directory (Path.cwd()) at runtime; no additional allowlist, content validation, or symlink-specific policy is declared in the supplied source.

Guard runs only inside save_image_to_artifact wired to the root agent's before_agent_callback (agent.py:29); the other registered callbacks (LoggingCallbacks, add_session_to_memory) perform logging/memory persistence and guard nothing.
The deny action is `continue` (skip the offending part), not an agent-invocation abort; whether skipping is sufficient containment for the overall run is not decided here.

The chained save_artifact write (callbacks.py:88-90) is a state-stratum effect reached only for admitted paths; it is gated by this same pre-open check and has no independently declared guard mechanism.
